notes.title: Version 1.5 - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Breaking Survivors is now 1 year old! Or well in 3 days to be precise, but I chose to roll the update early as the game was going on sale with the Autumn Sale today.

Anyway, the 1-year anniversary is here and with it come a rework of the Freeze Line artifact, improvements to the leaderboards with support for switching it to Friends only, a setting to freely pick your starting artifact (through rerolls) and some other minor improvements as well as a couple bug fixes.

Also, the game is going to be on sale at -40% for the next 14 days, first as part of the Autumn seasonal sale and then as part of the Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Rework - Freeze Line Artifact[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Freeze Line's freeze duration can't be upgraded anymore.[/b]
[*] [b]Freeze Line's Tier 2 and Tier 3 now add extra freeze lines above the initial one.[/b]
[*] [i]This is a big buff of the artifact overall, going from a 2.5/3.75/5s freeze used in a single go to a total of 2.5/5/7.5s freeze but in 1/2/3 go.[/i]
[*] [i]You can find a bit more details on the thoughts behind this rework at the bottom of this post.[/i]
[*] Used Freeze Lines are now greyed out rather than disappearing until the next wave.
[/list]
[h3]New Feature - Friends Leaderboards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam leaderboards can now be filtered to show only your friends.[/b]
[*] You can switch between Online, Friends & Personal leaderboards at any moment through the Settings menu. This will change the leaderboards displayed in the Leaderboards menu and on the Game Over screen.
[/list]
[h3]New Feature - Starting Artifact Rerolls[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Setting to be able to Reroll freely your starting artifact in runs.[/b]
[*] Starting Artifact Rerolls setting is off by default.
[*] [i]This doesn't change anything balance wise and is more of a quality of life feature if you want to start with a specific artifact, as you could just go back to the menu and relaunch the run until you'd get the right one.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Other Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Stats UI was completed with Health per Heart, Health Drops, Health To Shield, Base Shield, XP Duplicaion, XP Magnet Range & Danger Zone Slow.[/b] [i]All of these except Health per Heart are only shown once you pick the related artifacts.[/i]
[*] Triggering a Freeze while another Freeze is ongoing will now add to the current freeze duration rather than overriding it. [i]This can pretty much only happen if you level up and use the freeze powerup while the bricks are already frozen through Freeze Line.[/i]
[*] Lowered the volume of Menu SFXs slightly.
[*] Wave Start/End announcements now adapt to Danger Zone, Freeze Lines & Lower Limit to avoid any overlap between them.
[*] Slight improvements to the Pause & Game Over menu.
[*] Made the background of the Game Over screen leaderboards slightly more opaque to improve readability.
[*] Fixed 4+ digits ranks overflowing in the Leaderboards.
[*] Fixed the Upgrades Roll animation glitching upon rerolling before it was finished.
[*] Removed a couple unused Unity packages from the build, leading to a ~0.5MB file size improvement.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306360/06794059f6b5608275ba8aa973cbc88a9678e29e.gif[/img]
[i]The Freeze Line rework once max-ed with three lines.[/i]

[b]Couple thoughts on the game's balance / Idea behind the freeze line rework[/b]
One thing I've tried when designing Breaking Survivors was to have all balls and artifacts viable to some extent, allowing for a good variety of viable builds. And this was mostly a success, as if you check the builds in the leaderboards' top 100, you'll be able to see pretty much all balls and artifacts used in those runs.

Sure, overall there are some that are either more or less common, as it's impossible to have a perfect balance, but there are still a couple major outliers. Two (more precisely three) artifacts in particular are rather big outliers. On one side there was the Freeze Limit which is never used (iirc used only once among the top 100 of both Normal & Quick mode rankings). On the other side its alternative, the Danger Zone which is used in pretty much every single top run due to its strong synergy with Lower Limit.

Ideally, the Danger Zone + Lower Limit could use a nerf as it's clearly too strong while the Freeze Line ain't a bad artifact by itself. But a nerf would mean a reset of the leaderboard to avoid the current top scores might end up unreachable, and that's something I definitely wanted to avoid. Which meant the solution was to buff the Freeze Line so it'd be more of a viable alternative to the Danger Zone + Lower Limit combo allowing for new builds around it.

Also, if we look at the balls' stats in the leaderboards. Right now, the least used ball is by far the Boomerang ball (only ~4% of runs), as it tends to shine best when bricks are high and so synergizes well with Freeze Line and not at all with Danger Zone. Most used ball is the Phantom Ball, which works best when bricks are low and so with Danger Zone. So, the freeze line rework should also make Boomerang a more interesting option in builds and allow for more builds not relying on Phantom.

notes.title: Name Change & Explanations
notes.content:
As some might have noticed, the game was delisted from the store for the last couple weeks and is now back under the new name [b]Breaking Survivors[/b].

[b]So, what happened ?[/b]

I won't go much in detail with the legal stuff but here are the rough events of the last few weeks :
[list]
[*] Game received a DMCA takedown for copyright infringement
[*] Steam unlisted the game from the store (standard procedure, they have to do it preventively)
[*] Discussions with my lawyer and the other party
[*] DMCA takedown got withdrawn with a trademark infringement replacing it
[*] I changed the name of the game to comply
[*] Steam relisted the game as everything was fine now
[/list]

Basically, the old name (Breakout Survivors) was causing issues as "Breakout" is trademarked and I had to remove that from the game's title.
So, the game is now called Breaking Survivors and everything is fine now.

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
This month's update brings quite a few things. Content-wise, there is a new artifact that adds more replayability and should deepen your build options. Another new feature are the Personal Leaderboards that come in addition to the existing online ones and can be used to look at your history of runs. Another big change is an overhaul of the controller support, especially with PS Controllers to ensure full compatibility.

To celebrate this update, the game will be on a -20% sale for a full week (23rd February - 1st March).

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Artifact - Early Barrage[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Launches a Barrage upon Wave Start.[/b]
[*] This artifact doesn't have any upgrades linked to it as it scales with ball related upgrades already.
[*] It is unlocked by clearing Quick Mode's first 12 waves perfectly. [i]Unlocks aren't retroactive and players who had the achievement already will have to do it again to unlock the artifact sadly.[/i]
[*] [i]It has no incompatibilities.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]New Feature - Personal Leaderboards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Personal Leaderboards keep tracks of your runs and only your runs.[/b]
[*] You can switch between Online & Personal leaderboards at any moment through the Settings menu. This will change the leaderboards displayed in the Leaderboards menu and on the Game Over screen.
[*] Your runs are registered on both leaderboards, regardless of the setting you're using. [i]If you're on the Personal leaderboard, your runs still get uploaded to the Online one. And if you're using the Online leaderboard, your runs still get listed in the personal one.[/i]
[*] [i]Personal Leaderboard can be used to look at your history of runs, compare some of the builds you've tried, etc... or if you just want to hide the online leaderboards.[/i]
[*] [i]Previous runs made before the update weren't saved and so won't show up on the personal leaderboards.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Improved Controller Support / PlayStation Controller Support[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The game now fully supports PlayStation Controllers without the need of Steam Input.[/b]
[*] [b]Added an UI Buttons setting for Gamepad[/b] (in the Controls tab) [b]to force either Xbox or PS glyphes.[/b] [i]It is by default on Automatic detection which should display the right glyphes for your controller.[/i]
[*] [i]In case you're using Steam Input with a PS controller, the Automatic detection will fail as Steam Input emulates a generic controller with a Xbox layout. You should then use the above setting to force PS glyphes.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Other Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Barrage icon was reworked and should be clearer.
[*] Various parts of the UI (mainly Tabs like in Leaderboard or Settings) now reset their state upon switching between menus.
[*] Fixed a certain number of SFX not having their volume affacted by the SFX Volume Setting.
[*] Fixed certain Audio Tracks getting out of sync overtime.
[*] Fixed your own score flickering upon loading the leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
A new update for Breakout Survivors is out and it brings a new artifact that will open lots of build options as it interacts with balls. The update also brings a couple balance changes and an improved Upgrade Choices UI.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Artifact - Tier 3 Balls[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Unlocks Tier 3 Upgrades for your Balls but you are limited to 4 Balls Types max instead of 5.[/b]
[*] The Artifact itself doesn't have any upgrades (as it unlocks upgrades for balls instead).
[*] It is unlocked by Beating Wave 20 in Quick Mode. [i]Unlocks aren't retroactive and players who had the achievement already will have to do it again to unlock the artifact sadly.[/i]
[*] [i]It has no incompatibilities.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay & Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Freeze Line's duration has been increased from 2/3/4s to 2.5s/3.75s/5s.[/b]
[*] Heart Drops will now trigger immediately upon picking the artifact. [i]If you aren't full health already, that is.[/i]
[*] Fixed upgraded Phantom Ball spawning slightly in the player.
[/list]
[h3]UI & Menus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the Upgrade Choices UI.
[*] Upgrades now feature a colored border with the color based on the 'type' of upgrade. [i]Orange = artifact, blue = permanent upgrade, white = late game powerups[/i]
[*] Increased opacity of the Upgrade Choices' background. [i]This should help a bit with readability.[/i]
[*] Increased opacity of the Leaderboards' background. [i]Same, slightly better readability on the game over screen.[/i]
[*] Fixed Wave Start text showing up in the background during Artifacts selection.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
The end of year celebrations are here but so is Breakout Survivors' first content update since its release !

This update mainly brings in the XP Duplication artifact which brings you more XP from bricks and could be used as either an alternative to the XP Magnet or in addition to it to maximize your XP and leveling.
Other changes include an updated display order for the artifacts, some slight FX improvements and a number of bug fixes.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Artifact - XP Duplication[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]XP Duplication Artifacts gives you a chance to have double xp dropping from bricks.[/b]
[*] Initial artifact upgrade gives a 20% chance for XP to be double. Tier 2 and Tier 3 increase this chance to 35% and 50% respectively.
[*] It is unlocked by Clearing perfectly the first 8 Waves in Quick Mode. [i]Unlocks aren't retroactive and players who had the achievement will have to do it again to unlock the artifact sadly.[/i]
[*] [i]It has no incompatibilities.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Displayed order of the artifacts in Collection has been changed. [i]Artifacts are now regrouped by themes, ie. health-related, shield-related, xp-related, etc...[/i]
[*] Added some slight variations to the Ball Hits SFX so they're less repetitive.
[*] Hit & Death VFX for Splitting Ball's Small Balls are a bit smaller.
[*] Hit & Death SFX volumes for Splitting Ball's Small Balls are lower.
[*] Disabled the Resolution menu item while in Exclusive Full Screen.
[*] Fixed Resolutions not getting updated properly upon switching display.
[*] Fixed Balls' Hit Effects sometimes not triggering on Walls.
[*] Fixed Leaderboards crashing upon loading scores featuring artifacts/balls that are available in future versions. [i]Not retroactive. Ie. previous versions of the game won't load leaderboards properly with scores featuring the new artifact.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
It's been one week since the release and it's been great seeing the positive feedback from the community on the game since.

Now, it's time for the game's first real update though it's a rather small one as I spent a bit of time after release working on hotfixes then took a few needed days of break.
The main addition coming in this update is adding support for Mouse as a way to control the paddle meaning the game can now be played solely with the mouse if you want so (just like it can be played with keyboard only). Other improvements is adding a 'proper' support for Spanish - Latin America, as the game supports Spanish but wouldn't default to it for Latam users, fixing a few minor UI issues with the localization and improving the Steam Rich Presence.

You can read the full changelog below :

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Mouse Input (experimental)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Mouse can now be used to control your paddle.[/b] [i]Just move your mouse left/right and the paddle will follow accordingly.[/i]
[*] Added a setting to control the Mouse Sensibility for Paddle. [i]It only affects the paddle control and not the mouse in menus.[/i]
[*] Mouse's position is now at the center of the screen when upgrades appear or when you pause the game.
[*] [i]Mouse is considered as experimental for now and there might be some changes to it depending of feedback. If you run into any issues with it or have suggestions for improvements, feel free to make a post in the Steam Forums.[/i]
[*] [i]Mouse as an input for the paddle can also be disabled in the Settings. This might not stay long-term.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added proper Spanish Latam support.[/b]
[*] The game's language will now default to Spanish for Spanish Latam players. [i]This will only affect new players.[/i]
[*] Steam Rich Presence will show up in Spanish for Spanish Latam users.
[*] [FR] Fixed a typo in Quick Mode's description.
[*] [FR] Fixed a typo in Destroy Bricks' recurring upgrade description.
[*] [DE] Fixed the Game Mode tooltips overlapping in Play Menu.
[*] [DE] Fixed "Punktzahle" column title going over 2 lines in the leaderboards.
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new Controls tab in the Settings menu. [i]Gamepad Settings were moved to that new tab, along Mouse settings[/i]
[*] Steam Rich Presence now includes the current Game Mode in addition to the Wave #.
[*] One score was removed from the leaderboards due to either cheating or bug abuse.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next ?[/h2]

As said in the intro, that was a rather small update following the release. Now, the main focus for future updates will be on improving the gameplay and adding some new content (ie. balls & artifacts) to improve the replayability of the game, and a bit of QoL here and there too.
I'll also investigate possible issues with PlayStation controllers that were reported on the forums during next week (couldn't get to it earlier as it's not an easy thing to test as I only have Xbox controllers myself)

I don't have a set date for the next update yet but it will be coming within the next 15 days.

notes.title: 1 Week to Release - Upcoming Content Sneak Peek #2
notes.content:
It's only one week left until Breakout Survivors' release, so it's time for another sneak peek at the content from the full version of the game.

[h2]Reworked Variants System & Collection Menu Overhaul[/h2]

The Variants system for Balls & Artifacts got fully reworked into a more flexible.
Rather than having to select a variant before a run, all 'variants' are now available at once in runs (unless manually disabled). It's only once you pick a Ball or Artifact that any incompatible item gets removed from the pools of upgrades/artifacts.
This makes for a more flexible system as certain balls/artifacts can be incompatible with any number of upgrades. Ie. the Health to Shield Artifact (see below) is not only incompatible with the Health Drops artifact but also the Heal late-game recurring upgrade.

What used to be 'variants' within a same ball/artifact set are incompatible with each other.

The Collection Menu also had a slight overhaul to match the new system and making it clear what is incompatible with a ball/artifact.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1177260749941391391/collectionMenuRework2.gif[/img]

[h2]Chaotic Random Ball[/h2]

A variation of the Random Ball that changes type every time it bounces on anything, hence it being rather chaotic.

[i]Incompatible with Random Ball & Light Random Ball.[/i]

[h2]Duplicate Ball Artifact[/h2]

The Duplicate Ball Artifact allows you to have the same ball twice within your build by replacing a normal ball by one of your upgraded balls.

This opens up a lot of possibilities build-wise as it allows to make builds heavily focused on a single ball type.

[i]Duplicate Ball artifact can't show up if the conditions for it to work aren't met. You need to have at least one special ball & one normal ball in your build for it to show.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1177260748729229312/duplicateBallArt.gif[/img]

[h2]Bigger Hearts Artifact[/h2]

Bigger Hearts Artifact works kinda as a multiplier to your Max Health as you can increase the amount of Health Points of your Hearts.

Synergies : Health Drops artifact, Heal (late game recurring upgrade)

[i]Various tooltips were reworked to be clear that they were working with Hearts.[/i]

[h2]Health To Shield Artifact[/h2]

Health to Shield caps your current health points to 1 but gives you a % of your Max Health into Shield.

It can provide a big amount of Shield, making it perfect to get easier Perfect Clears (as you only need not to lose life for them). However if your shield depletes, you're pretty much done with only 1 hp. That makes it a risky but high reward artifact.

Synergies : Shield artifact & Bigger Hearts artifact for Shield-heavy builds. Shield Refills late game recurring upgrades.

[i]Incompatible with Health Drops artifact as well as Heal late game recurring upgrade.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1177260749391925248/healthToShieldArtifact.gif[/img]

notes.title: 2 Weeks to Release - Upcoming Content Sneak Peek #1
notes.content:
With Breakout Survivors' release being in two weeks (30th November), it is time to showcase some of the content that wasn't in the demo and that will be available in the full game.

[h2]Quick Mode[/h2]

Quick Mode is a whole new Game Mode with a different balance.
It is faster paced and has shorter runs.

It also has its own separate leaderboard and will feature a number of specific achievements.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1174814316277538826/quickModeMenu.gif[/img]

[h2]Backstab Ball[/h2]

Backstab Ball is a ball that teleports on top of bricks when hitting them.
At first, it can go through one brick at once with its tier 2 ugprade allows it to go through two bricks at once.

This ball has a very distinct clearing pattern as it can go near instantly to the top of the screen, by chaining backstabs and can bounce a lot in between bricks doing high amounts of damages.

Possible Synergies : Homing Ball as they focus the closest bricks while Backstab mostly clears the back.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1174814317087051846/backstabduplicateshort.gif[/img]

[h2]Danger Zone[/h2]

Danger Zone is an Artifact that acts as a buffer zone above the limit.
When there are bricks within the zone, the fall speed of all bricks will be slowed down, giving you more time to clear those bricks before they hit you.

Possible Synergies : Lower Limit will increase the size of the Danger Zone improving considerably its effect.
[i]Incompatible with Freeze Line.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1174814317993001132/dangerZoneArtifact.gif[/img]

[h2]Freeze Line[/h2]

Freeze Line is an Artifact that adds an extra line above the limit.
Whenever a brick reaches that line, it triggers a few seconds of Freeze so you can clear bricks and get back to a safe situation.
The Freeze Line can only be triggered once per wave.

[i]Incompatible with Danger Zone.[/i]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1140340763272675429/1174814318571823134/freezeLineArtifact.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bullet Heaven Fest + Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]Breakout Survivors is part of the Bullet Heaven Fest going from 6 November to 20 November.[/b]
Bullet Heaven Fest is an event celebrating the recent Bullet Heaven or Survivors-like genre with nearly 200 games taking part in it. Lots of these games will be on sale or have demos available during the next two weeks.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41046058/sale/BulletHeavenFest]Check the full event here.[/url]

For the occasion, [b]the game's demo is receiving an update[/b].
It mainly brings in a fully reworked collections menu, a slight rework of the Boomerang Ball and minor QoL & improvements. However, there's no major content addition in the update as new balls & artifacts are saved for the game's full release.


See the full changelog below.

[h2]Demo Update Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Collections Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Collections Menu has been reworked from the ground up ![/b]
[*] When hovering the Collection Menu Button, the current balls & artifacts set-up is shown.
[*] A full list of the Balls/Artifacts & their state (selected/not selected/locked) is now displayed at the top.
[*] Additional Upgrades (Balls' Tier 2 & some Artifacts extra upgrades) are now showcased when you're selecting a Ball/Artifact.
[*] Your Balls/Artifacts set-up is now saved & kept between game sessions or throughout your devices (through Steam Cloud).
[*] [i]Collection menu also shows some of the balls & artifacts that'll be part of the full game, but are locked.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved/Reworked Boomerang Ball's player homing.[/b] It doesn't always aim for the player's center anymore meaning it is a lot easier to put effects into it and send it with an angle rather than vertically.
[*] Fixed Combo Ball not working properly with Random Ball and always having a multiplier of x1/x2. Combo Ball from Random Ball now have the right multiplier for the amount of times you've caught that ball.
[/list]
[h3]UI & Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Artifacts' Icons are now colored.[/b]
[*] When using the Freeze Bricks late-game powerup, the freeze timer is now shown next to the Limit Line.
[*] The Spawn line that appears at start of waves/when no bricks are below it is now dotted.
[*] On the Main Menu, quitting the game now requires pressing Escape (keyboard) or B/Home (Gamepad) twice unless you're already on the Quit button. First key/button press will move the 'cursor' on the Quit button. [i]This avoids closing the game unintentionally while navigating menus.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random Balls Variants now have distinct names. "Random Ball" is the one that changes upon bouncing on the player, while the one that only has random at spawn now is "Light Random Ball".
[*] Few minor changes to some balls/artifacts/upgrades' descriptions & localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Conclusion & Demo Update (version a14)
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is coming to an end and it was a blast seeing so many people test the game and enjoying it.

As of writing this post, over 380 players have tested the demo since last sunday, doing nearly 1.9k runs and clearing 8.9k waves (73% of which were perfect clears). Out of all those runs, exactly 100 went past Wave 20.
I was also quite surprised to see Wave 25 getting beaten with user PahiChannel being the first (and so far only one) to get past it with the current highest score in the leaderboards.

I received lots of positive feedbacks as well as a number of issues and bug reports throughout the week which will help me improve the game.

The demo will not only remain available after Next Fest but is also getting an update fixing some of the bugs that were spotted as well as bringing an improved Leaderboard menu which now includes Artifacts as well as a few minor QoL improvements. You can find the full list of changes further below.

Now, the main issues that were raised about the game/demo were that there's too few content right now & that the collections menu was quite unclear.
Adding new balls & artifacts to give the game more strategical depth and a better replayibility will be my focus for the next few weeks. I've already got a few fun new balls and artifacts planned & designed that only need to get implemented in the game. The collection menu will also get a full overhaul along the way as it is very basic in its current state, but will get expanded as it won't be just picking balls/artifacts but also unlock new ones and I'll try to make things there a lot more clearer.

Next major update to the demo will come in early November for the upcoming Bullet Heaven Fest, then the full game is planned to release on November 30.

[h2]Version a14 Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Random Balls' 2nd Chance losing their Random component upon running out of lives.
[*] Shortened and thinned the trails of Splitting Ball's children. [i]This should make these small balls stand out a bit less & make it easier to spot other balls amidst the mess.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Leaderboards received a major overhaul and now include Artifacts.[/b]
[*] Balls column has been renamed Build.
[*] Hovering/Navigating to an entry in the leaderboard will now expand the entry and show the artifacts next to the balls. [i]Runs that were made before tuesday's small update will only show a "+" there as artifacts weren't saved along scores at the time.[/i]
[*] Leaderboard Lines now have alternating background colors.
[*] Your own entry in the leaderboard is now showcased in blue rather than being in italic. [i]This makes it easier to spot yourself.[/i]
[*] Fixed a bug where your score would be sent several times at once to the server, leading to the score being ignored by the server.
[*] Fixed Names with non Latin characters not showing up properly in Leaderboards. 
[/list]
[h3]Other Menus & UIs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Score Gain from Perfect Clears & Extra Score upgrades is now shown as a "+XXX" next to the score.
[*] Score text 'growth' animation is now more emphasized on big score changes (like perfect clears & extra score upgrades).
[*] Perfect Clear & Reinforced Waves texts are slightly bigger.
[*] Fixed Menus' Tabs (such as in Leaderboards or Settings) not working correctly when interacted with mouse.
[/list]

notes.content:
A quick update bringing some minor improvements to the leaderboards.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard on the Game Over screen is now centered on your score rather than always showing the top 10.
[*] Artifacts are now saved along scores for newer runs. [i]They're not displayed in the leaderboards for now.[/i]
[/list]
